comparison.objective: Align two flanges and assemble four pins through corresponding holes.
comparison.physical_skill: Six-DOF flange registration followed by repeated discrete pin insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Flanges aligned and all four pins physically inserted/seated in their intended holes.
comparison.reason: Multi-hole registration and pin insertion test discrete connector alignment. The candidate instead requires continuous parallel raceway support during bearing-block translation, with any ball loss invalidating success.
